title: 22-Inch Double Glass Shelf With Gallery Rail (Wall Mount) | Waverly Place Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Clear bathroom counter space and keep daily essentials organized with a wall-mounted double glass shelf designed for secure, easy-to-reach storage.

  • More storage without crowding: double shelf design creates two tiers for toiletries and décor.
  • Items stay put: gallery rail is designed to keep bottles and accessories in place.
  • Built for daily use: 3/8-inch thick tempered glass adds safety and strength.
  • Clean, coordinated look: concealed screw mounting hardware and compatibility with the Waverly Place collection for matching Waverly Place, transitional bath accessories.
  • Enduring hardware: solid brass components support a refined, transitional style.

Specs & Installation

  • Glass dimensions: 22 x 5 inches
  • Overall size: 22 in L x 5 in projection x 8 in H
  • Glass thickness: 0.38 in (3/8-inch), tempered
  • Weight capacity: 4 lb
  • Mounting: wall mount with concealed screw hardware
  • Assembly required: No
  • Includes: glass shelf and all installation hardware (screws: #8 x 1 1/4")

Tempered glass is 3/8 Inches thick and all of the hardware is made of solid brass and finished with the highest quality materials to provide a lifetime of beauty.
